title: Use 3D Motion Control on your phone to direct the scene, then upload that…
content: Use 3D Motion Control on your phone to direct the scene, then upload that motion reference to Seedance 2.5 to generate cinematic sequences.
tips: Use 3D Motion Control on your phone to direct the scene, then upload that motion reference to Seedance 2.5 to generate cinematic sequences.

es.content:
Usa el control de movimiento 3D en tu teléfono para dirigir la escena y luego sube esa referencia de movimiento a Seedance 2.5 para generar secuencias cinematográficas.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] Seedance 2.5 está disponible en Magnific
---
